column1: # boru Language Specification: Dispatch edge cases 2 — family-restricted
# ordering vs tcmp totality, type-literal operand ordering, the left-side
# predicate-construction gotcha, and the equality lattice.
# cmp / lt / lte / gt / gte are FAMILY-RESTRICTED (compare-restrict.tsv):
# a cross-family pair raises [boru/incomparable]. tcmp is TOTAL: the same
# pair orders by the unified lattice Rank (compare.tsv). This file walks
# the frontier BETWEEN those two suites: for each cross-family pair the
# restricted word errors AND tcmp still answers — plus the asymmetric
# type-literal rules, where a type literal on the RIGHT of an ordering
# word is an ordinary operand (literal sorts first within its family),
# but a type literal on the LEFT of lt/lte/gt/gte CONSTRUCTS a predicate
# type (a DepScalar) instead of comparing at all.
